sentences.text:
This Crl.M.C. under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is filed by the accused in Crime No.3167 of 2017 of Chavara Police Station, Kollam District, which is now pending before the Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), Karunagappally as LP No.4/2021, to quash the non- bailable warrant pending against him.
2. The petitioner was charge sheeted for the offence punishable under Section 376(2) of the Indian Penal Code and he was granted anticipatory bail by this Court as per Annexure A1 order dated 7.1.2020.
There was no direction in that order, that he shall not go abroad and accordingly, to eke out a living, he went to Ukraine on 9.1.2021.

Thereafter, due to COVID-19 pandemic restrictions and also due to the civil war in Ukraine, he could not come back to India and by that time, due to his absence, the case was transferred to LP Register as LP No.4/2021.
Now, the petitioner is available in India and he wants to surrender before the Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), Karunagappally.
His prayer is to quash the non-bailable warrant pending against him, so as to enable him to surrender before the court.

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, and learned Public Prosecutor, on behalf of the respondents /State.
4. Earlier the petitioner was released on Anticipatory Bail and there was no restriction for him to go abroad.
Accordingly, he went abroad.
Thereafter, due to COVID- 19 pandemic and the civil war in Ukraine, he could not come back.
So, the petitioner is at liberty to surrender before the Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), Karunagappally in LP No.4/2021 on or before 25.1.2024 and file an application for bail.
The learned trial court shall consider his application, on evaluating the factual situations pleaded by him, and dispose the application on the date of surrender itself.
Till the petitioner surrenders before the Fast Track Special Court, the non-bailable warrant pending against him in LP No.4/2021 shall be kept in abeyance.
With these directions, this Crl.M.C. is disposed of.

Sd/-
